name: @listmonk-ops/operations
description: Shared typed operations for listmonk-ops CLI and MCP adapters

scripts.generate:specs: bun run generate:specs:contracts && bun run generate:specs:artifacts
scripts.build: bun run generate:specs:check && bun run specs:governance && bun run specs:stable:check && bun run clean && ttsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts src/specs/index.ts --bundle --platform=neutral --format=esm --outbase=src --outdir=dist --minify --external:@listmonk-ops/openapi --external:zod && bun ./scripts/check-spec-subpath.ts
scripts.test: bun run generate:specs:check && bun run specs:governance && bun run specs:stable:check && bun test
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test
